summary: Today brings a mixed legal and retail landscape driven by Nielsen's report on expanding FMCG e-commerce market share and Gauhati High Court's criminal procedure ruling. Corporate activity is further anchored by Reliance Jio's global partnership talks and fresh capital market filings.

bullets.text: E-commerce share in India's FMCG retail sales tripled over the past two years, according to a report by Nielsen.
Gauhati High Court ruled that a quashing petition under Section 528 BNSS is premature before the trial court takes cognizance of the offence.
Reliance Jio is exploring tech-for-equity partnership talks with US telecommunications giants Comcast and Charter Communications.
Dhanteras gold sales value surged on price drops, though overall volumes remained flat compared to last year, according to the GJC.
Cyril Amarchand Mangaldas acted as legal counsel to underwriters for EAAA India Alternatives Limited's ₹12,000 million initial public offering.
